topography.project_purpose: Liquidity Manager. Structurally: 96 project-authored contract(s) across 6 chain(s); 5 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 2 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 10 functional families. Its contracts share 20 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, ownableuninitialized, reentrancyguardupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
